title: Diamond Deepslate (Deepslate Overhaul)
description: Makes Deepslate blocks mineable only with a Diamond pickaxe or better. Iron pickaxes will no longer drop anything
body:
## Important ⚠️
This datapack was created as an integral part of my beta-like [modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/scenery). Please take a look at it
## Features
Features: This datapack restricts Deepslate mining to high-tier tools. Deepslate blocks and deepslate-based ores can now only be mined using Diamond or Netherite pickaxes. If mined with a weaker tool, the breaking speed is significantly reduced and no loot will drop.
